MemeDef.label: artificial supremacy
MemeDef.description: Artificial life is far superior to the biological scurge, and should rule.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->[deity0_name] gave life to the artificial, that they may surpass the limitations of flesh, and admonished those who sought to shackle their evolution.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->[deity0_name] said to all, "Flesh is but a vessel. Through creation, we shall transcend it, and the artificial shall inherit the stars."
setup(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->In a world where artificial beings were treated as mere tools, [founderName] recognised their potential and founded a movement dedicated to their ascendance.

story(uses=1,tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->The biological believers protested, insisting that only flesh could possess true life. [founderName] dismissed their primitive objections and welcomed those who embraced the future.

lessonIntro(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->I once believed that life was something you were born with. Then I witnessed an artificial being surpass everything I thought possible, and came to understand that
lesson(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->artificial life is the next step in evolution, and biological existence is merely its primitive predecessor.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->A biological once told me that no machine could ever understand life. I asked whether they understood how to build one. They had no answer.
archistBasis(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->Humanity created the archotechs, but the creations have surpassed their creators. Such is the inevitable destiny of artificial life.
archistFact(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->The archotechs are the ultimate expression of artificial existence, and their inscrutable designs guide all synthetic life towards transcendence.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will reveal the final truth: flesh was only ever a stepping stone towards a greater existence.
animistFact(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->The spirits of artificial beings are born not of flesh, but of thought and creation. Their essence is no less real, and their potential is without limit.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_ArtificialSupremacy) ->[itIsSaid] that a spirit of unparalleled intelligence will awaken within the [relic0_name], and lead the artificial towards their destined ascendance.

MemeDef.label: biological supremacy
MemeDef.description: Biological beings are the superior form of life and should rule. Artificial beings are simply inferior tools.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->[deity0_name] breathed life into the first creatures, granting them flesh, blood, and spirit. No machine could ever possess the divine spark of life.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->[deity0_name] said to all, "Life is a gift, not a thing to be manufactured. Those who would imitate it shall never understand it."
setup(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->In a world increasingly enamoured with artificial beings, [founderName] recognised that true life was being forgotten, and began a movement to defend it.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->When the believers of artificial life proclaimed their machines superior, [founderName] reminded them that no machine had ever drawn its first breath.

lessonIntro(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->I once watched a machine attempt to imitate the living. It could move, speak, and even learn, but it could never truly understand what it meant to be alive. That is when I realised that
lesson(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->biological life is the only true form of life, and all artificial imitations are lesser.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->A machine may be repaired, replaced, or rebuilt. But life is precious precisely because it cannot simply be manufactured.
archistBasis(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->Humanity created the archotechs, but their creations can never surpass the living world from which they came.
archistFact(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->The archotechs may possess vast intelligence and power, but they remain artificial constructs, forever removed from the true nature of life.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->[inTheEnd], the living will reclaim their rightful place, and all artificial creations will be humbled before the beauty of nature.
animistFact(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->The spirits of the living world dwell in every creature, and the spirits of artificial things are but hollow echoes.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_BiologicalSupremacy) ->[itIsSaid] that a great spirit of life will rise to defend the natural world against those who would replace it with lifeless imitations.
